decision.title: Keys and XSLT functions (packet )
decision.summary: An XSLT function table puts stylesheet functions and the XSLT-only library part before the processor's; xsl:key indexes are built lazily with map:build once per evaluation and tree through an evaluation memo.

body.p: , after , , , , , . src/xslt_key.c with src/xslt_key_internal.h, src/function_library_xslt.c, tests/xslt_key_test.c; no IR kind, no public header.

item.p: XSLT function table (glossary): sxml_xslt_declare_functions puts one table in front of every static context of the stylesheet (before 4.12's components table): stylesheet functions lowered into the unit, then the rows of the XSLT-only library parts (: parts whose language set has XSLT and not XPath), then the processor's table. A stylesheet function becomes an IR function when an expression first names it; sxml_xslt_lower_functions lowers the bodies asked for (twice: before the templates are released, again after the global variables).

Library part xslt (sxml_function_library_xslt_languages = SXML_LANGUAGE_XSLT): system-property, available-system-properties, function-available, element-available, type-available (moved from src/xslt_static.c, which now serves its expressions the first five rows, sxml_xslt_static_functions), current, document (4.0 options map or base node), unparsed-entity-uri and -public-id (the zero-length value: trees keep no unparsed entities). Names given as strings resolve against the running unit's static namespaces (): a static expression's own, a stylesheet's those of the invocation's template (), not each expression's (Proposed below).

fn:current: a parameter default SXML_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_CURRENT_ITEM (function_library_internal.h); lowering reads focus part CURRENT_ITEM, the focus the innermost embedding started with (sxml_xpath_lowerer.embedding_focus, set in the embedding frame), so in a pattern it is the item matched (). Inside an inline function it is UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE (it would need a capture).

Entries taking the caller's context value themselves: an entry whose parameter_types already cover the parameters the caller supplies is called as it is instead of the entry of the longer arity (src/xpath_lower.c, static calls and references). fn:key#2 is an IR function (key-name, key-value, context) distinct from fn:key#3.

Keys (20.2): the declarations of one name are one key (XTSE1222 when collation or composite differ; XTSE1205 for use and content, or neither). Its build function is map:build over the tree's nodes and attributes with the use values of each matching declaration (match-N: the match function in a TRY_CATCH giving false, 6.5; use-N: the attribute or sequence constructor with the node as fixed focus) as keys; fn:key dispatches on the resolved name and looks values up in the index that the internal row key-index returns. Key values: string-like as xs:string, or their collation key under a non-codepoint collation; numbers as xs:double (eq promotes, so 3.7 matches number('3.7')); a composite key is one string of tagged canonical texts. Result: /. (document order, no duplicates); fn:key#3 keeps descendants-or-self of $top; fn:key#2 raises XTDE1270 when the root is not a document node.

Evaluation memo (glossary; src/evaluator.c, additive to evaluator_internal.h): entries (computation address and number, subject node by identity) to a value, released when the evaluation ends. key-index calls the build function on a miss (a resumable body, ) and stores the map: each index is built once per evaluation and tree, lazily. 4.12 (xsl:function cache) and 4.14 (accumulators) can use the same memo.

fn:copy-of is xsl:copy-of's copy (sxml_xslt_lowering_bind_copy_of, exported from src/xslt_lower_construct.c); fn:snapshot an XPath text over fn:copy-of, fold-right and computed constructors (ancestors with their attributes and namespaces).

Patterns ( amended): a step whose predicates are all non-positional (each a comparison, logical, instance-of, castable or quantified expression, a string or boolean literal, nodes, or a call of a listed boolean or string function, and none names position or last) is tested on the item with a singleton focus instead of being selected again from its origin (6.3.2.3 gives the same result). attr/match runs in 12 s in a debug build (match-242 was 60 s alone).

Left to other packets: current-group, current-grouping-key, current-merge-* (4.9), regex-group (4.11), accumulator-before/-after (4.14), current-output-uri (4.13), xsl:evaluate (4.7: XTDE3175, ), fn:apply-templates (needs the mode at run time; 5 cases), fn:transform (out of scope), function-available at run time (the dynamic context's table is the host's: Proposed).
